correctness.rationale: The affine divisor formula has integral lower-block correction p(p-1)C_{2p}; all non-p denominators are excluded by cyclotomic norms. The odd-root trace is an integer. The primitive p^2 trace has valuation greater than -2p. The primitive-p trace is twice a Newton power sum, and its unique k_d=2p+2 term has valuation exactly -2p while each other term has valuation at least -2p+1; a complete factorial case analysis proves this last assertion. Six exact-rational examples and small published values were reproduced from the packaged program. Computations are illustrative, not proof of the universal claim.

value.rationale: The rational denominator of a naturally defined affine-permutation sum is a motivated exact arithmetic invariant. Determining it uniformly at the first prime-square layer distinguishes qualitative growth from the known first-prime denominator law, and supplies a structural constraint on further prime-power generalizations; it is not merely a single numerical instance.
